text: Oh no! Betsy's paw print trail has disappeared. What are we going to do now?
notes: Worried, but still gentle. Leave a beat after the question.

text: Maybe if we find all of the snakes they'll tell us where she went.
notes: Hopeful, like you've had an idea.

text: Can you find the snake with the letter
notes: The letter name plays right after this. End on an up-tone, no pause at the end.

text: Hmm... look closely at the snakes. I think I see it!
notes: After 2 wrong taps. The engine pulses the right snake.

text: There it is! Tap the snake that's sparkling.
Great job, Reign! Let's see if the snakes can help us! Snakes, have you seen Betsy?
notes: Proud, then calling out to the snakes.

text: Hmm... Brown, delicious-looking kitty? She wandered down this trail not too long ago.
notes: The snake's voice. Slow, slithery, silly. 'Delicious-looking' is the fun part.

text: Did you hear that, Reign? Let's follow Betsy down this trail!
notes: Excited. After this the trail glows and she taps it.

text: Tap the glowing trail to follow Betsy!
